changes.transport: Three attempts per exact request; 1200-second timeout per formal attempt; 5/15-second backoff; kill owned process group, including descendants.
changes.service_outage: After request attempts are exhausted, retain pending native step, cooldown 60 seconds, then retry; no GPU ledger reset.
changes.concurrency: Four active LLM subprocesses shared across the two runs; four single-GPU training slots and 64 CPU cores per run.
changes.cache: Successful request responses scoped to one run and its trajectory/iteration or candidate feedback. Completed per-user calls and full feedback can be reused after interruption.
changes.native_checkpoint: Versioned native database checkpoints with hash verification, population, islands, best program and iteration. Pending parent and inspirations are persisted.
changes.training_resume: Exact source/files and iteration scope identify already-trained candidates; original receipts and cost are reused instead of retraining.
changes.protocol: Two fresh independent searches; each 43200 GPU seconds, same prepared inputs and seeds, gpt-6.1-sol/medium; final single-model validation selection before test.
changes.preflight: 14 regression checks, actual eight-GPU short training/diagnostics, two real transport probes and a full twenty-user feedback chain.
